notes.title: Minor Update - Loc font changes
notes.notes: Improved readability of Chinese font and addressed some minor issues with certain Brazilian Portuguese characters.

notes.title: Minor fixes and localisation support
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Added support for Simplified Chinese and Brazilian Portuguese (thanks to Quantic Lab for the help!)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved game start flow UI, you can now select difficulty before starting each game,[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed multiple minor bugs[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Minor patch to fix endgame exploit
notes.notes: Fixed issue where in some circumstances the "continue" button would allow the player to replay the last turn of a round over and over again

notes.title: Buxfix for map generation issue
notes.notes: Fixes an issue where, In some circumstances, tutorial map data may be come corrupted - resulting in a broken map.

notes.title: Tree Kingdoms available now!
notes.notes:
[p]We're delighted to announce that Tree Kingdoms is now available on Steam! 

Its been such a wild ride and we're just thrilled to get the game into player's hands. 


Thanks so much to all the playtesters and everyone who's given us feedback so far - we couldn't have done it without you! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504207/f7af9c541e770bb33b180efae34f409fcee75837.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Steam Deck Update is Here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Sound the horns, Tree Kingdoms runs on Steam Deck! [/h1][p][/p][h3]In the run up to our Next Fest demo we've been iterating away with lots of fixes and updates - but the most exciting is having the game running and feeling good on Steam Deck.   We've had Steam Deck support in mind for this game since Day 1 so its super thrilling for us to get it into our players hands with our Next Fest demo - which is now live![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504207/2cc050c053c6ea44c1fb79e7016993e96788c3e5.jpg"][/img]  [/h3][h1] [/h1][p][/p][h1]We need your feedback! [/h1][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504207/40ba93faf56e8d424eb3f2c0a080e39ac81db852.png"][/img]Its certainly not going to be perfect the first time out, so we'd really appreciate any feedback you might have on how it plays. Do the controls feel right? Are there aspects you'd change, or things you'd expect to happen with certain inputs which we're not doing? 

Anything you let us know about will help us improve the experience before we submit the game for Steam Deck verification, and make the game the best it can be for launch. 


Let us know either in our community pages or via the feedback link in the demo itself. 
We hope you enjoy! 

And as always a big thank you to everyone who's RT'd, Wishlisted, and shared the game so far. It means the world to this tiny team. 


And of course.... 
[b]If you like what we're making - tell someone about it![/b] [/h3]

notes.title: Fresh out the oven!
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Fellow tree spirits it's almost time to get your hands on [i][b]Tree Kingdoms[/b][/i]! [/b][/h2]

We've been working frantically to knock everything off our wishlist and the game is looking great if we do say so ourselves. 

Here's a quick summary of the latest updates:

[list]
[h3]New music by Thomas O'Boyle (Composer on Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark
Fog of war updated to cloud visual (which is much more in keeping with the game style)
Ice Mesh updated with frozen visuals
New water's edge added to map border
And a bunch of UI and UX optimisations![/h3]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UKm5h5d.gif[/img]


Overall the gameplay is in a wonderful place and we're mostly tackling little behind the scenes things to make the game much more user friendly outside the core experience. 

Thank you so much for your Wishlists, RTs and other support, it's super important for a tiny team like ours. And If you've not shared [i][b]Tree Kingdoms[/b][/i] with a buddy, there's no better time than today!
